items.title: Binance Hackers Move Nearly $600M in Ethereum Through THORChain
items.summary: Wallets linked to the $6.3 billion Binance hack saw the Binance hackers move approximately $594 million worth of Ethereum over two days, routing portions of the stolen assets through cross-chain protocols THORChain and Chainflip.
